answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 45% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the cipher calculation reruns each epoch, the reef weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the ripple settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 73 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 6 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
